cards.headline: Packaging/testing quality: unusual results.
cards.body: When teams review unusual test results, first align on the lot and test time behind each record.
cards.caption: We provide manufacturing ERP solutions. Packaging and testing quality teams: use three questions to clarify test records, review context and the next check.

cards.headline: 1. Which lot are we reviewing?
cards.body: Do the lot ID, process stage and test time match the record? If lots were split or merged, are the relationships between records clear?
cards.alt: Illustration: 1. Which lot are we reviewing?
cards.caption: We provide manufacturing ERP solutions. Packaging and testing quality teams: use three questions to clarify test records, review context and the next check.

cards.headline: 2. What context needs checking?
cards.body: What do the records show about people, machines, materials, methods and environment? What else needs checking before discussing causes?
cards.caption: We provide manufacturing ERP solutions. Packaging and testing quality teams: use three questions to clarify test records, review context and the next check.

cards.headline: 3. Who checks what is missing?
cards.body: Identify the source to confirm, the person checking it and the missing information. Agree on the next reviewer and what to add to the shared basis.
cards.alt: Illustration: 3. Who checks what is missing?
cards.caption: We provide manufacturing ERP solutions. Packaging and testing quality teams: use three questions to clarify test records, review context and the next check.

cards.headline: Review records, context and owners together.
cards.body: Use a shared basis to discuss the next check. This information-management perspective complements the technical evaluation.
